messages:
Alex: Morning! Tiny holiday poll: are we doing an office door-decor contest this year? Winner gets the coveted 'desk plant watering duty' exemption for one week. :seedling: :trophy:

Chloe: Heck yes. I have a string of lights with tiny dinosaurs, very on-brand. Count me in. :brontosaurus:

Zara: Vote: :one: yes, :two: no, :three: only if snacks involved. I will lobby snacks. :cookie: :yum:

Miguel: Also thinking of a 15-min 'holiday pet parade' on Friday where people can show pets or festive plants on a quick Zoom. Low key. Thoughts? :dog: :cat:

Owen: Love both ideas. Door contest + pet parade = perfect mid-afternoon morale boost. Can we make the parade a lunchtime optional so people can join from home?

Katherine: If snacks are part of it, I will donate a tin of shortbread. Also happy to judge door decor if needed. :handshake:

Alex: Poll time: react with :one: for door contest, :two: for pet parade, :three: for both. I'll tally at 2pm.

patron-bot: "Reminder: All-hands cookie donations due Thursday 16:00 PST."

Chloe: Photo: (uploaded) "dino_lights_preview.jpg"
"Preview of the dinos on my door. They also sing when the light sensor detects motion. Mostly charming, sometimes alarming." :laughing:

Zara: GIF: <https://giphy.com/gifs/holiday-pets-3o6Zt8MgUuvSbkZYWc> 

Miguel: I'll bring my very calm golden retriever to the Zoom parade. He is a professional napper but will wear antlers. :antlers: 

Owen: If anyone wants help hanging stuff on the office doors, I can swing by Thursday morning. Also happy to be an impartial judge (within reason).

Katherine: Reactions so far: :one: x3, :two: x2, :three: x4. Looks like both wins. Bringing cookies for snacks.

Alex: Official plan: Door contest sign-up sheet in the kitchen tomorrow, pet parade Friday 12:30pm PST (Zoom link in calendar), photos of doors due Friday 11am so judges can review. Prizes: 1) Exemption mug (no plant duty) 2) Fancy office tea (runner-up) 3) Bragging rights.

Chloe: Minor PSA: please no glitter confetti on doors. Facilities still thinks glitter is a hazardous long-term resource. :sweat_smile:

Zara: Also if anyone needs tape or extra lights, ask in thread and I'll drop a kit at the front desk later today.

patron-bot: "Pinned: Holiday door contest rules & sign-up (kitchen clipboard)."

Miguel: Bringing antlers AND cookies. This is a very efficient holiday strategy.

Owen: Will someone remind me to actually put a decoration on my door and not just promise it? :grimacing:

Alex: I'll ping again tomorrow morning with the sign-up link and the Zoom URL. Thanks team 1 :sparkles: 

Katherine: Tiny holiday cheer: virtual high-five to everyone who participates. :raised_hands:"
